name: sibling_outputs
source:
fn show(left: Bool) { if left { val owner = String.from("left") println(owner.as_str()) } else { val owner = String.from("right") println(owner.as_str()) } }
fn main() { show(true) show(false) }

name: sibling_early_return
source:
fn show(left: Bool) -> Int32 { if left { val owner = String.from("early-left") println(owner.as_str()) return 11 } else { val owner = String.from("early-right") println(owner.as_str()) return 22 } }
fn main() { println(show(true)) println(show(false)) }

name: nested_siblings
source:
fn show(left: Bool, inner: Bool) { if left { val owner = String.from("left-parent") if inner { val value = String.from("left-inner") println(value.as_str()) } else { val value = String.from("left-else") println(value.as_str()) } println(owner.as_str()) } else { val owner = String.from("right-parent") if inner { val value = String.from("right-inner") println(value.as_str()) } else { val value = String.from("right-else") println(value.as_str()) } println(owner.as_str()) } }
fn main() { show(true, true) show(true, false) show(false, true) show(false, false) }
stdout:
left-inner
left-parent
left-else
left-parent
right-inner
right-parent
right-else
right-parent

name: loop_siblings
source:
fn show(left: Bool) { var again = true loop again { if left { val owner = String.from("loop-left") println(owner.as_str()) } else { val owner = String.from("loop-right") println(owner.as_str()) } again = false } }
fn main() { show(true) show(false) }
